items.content_html: Traditional crop disease diagnosis is a slow, error-prone process requiring expert botanical knowledge that is often inaccessible to everyday farmers. To prevent devastating yield losses, this project is a lightweight, AI-driven diagnostic tool that leverages transfer learning to instantly and identify 38 distinct plant diseases from leaf images.
